item.tib: mdo sde dam pa yid bzhin nor bu'i khyung sgrub kyi skyabs sems gsol 'debs
item.coloph: ces pa'i mdo chog khyung sgrub kyi skyabs sems gsol 'debs 'di ltar dgos zhes khyung po mtshams pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rnam dag don ldanaM g.yung drung rnam dag sogs kyi (kyis) bskul ngor bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling bris pa dge gyur cig/
